note: Values copied exactly from Murata catalog Cat.No.O63E-10 'Ferrite Core for EMI Suppression / Core for Flat Cables'. Impedance is |Z| typ. at 1 turn. Murata's catalog table publishes ONLY ONE spot per part: |Z| at 100 MHz. It does NOT tabulate a 10 MHz (or 30 MHz) value; only an impedance-vs-frequency graph per type is shown (not machine-readable, not transcribed here to avoid inventing values). The per-part product pages that formerly published a second spot at 10 MHz have been removed from Murata's live catalog (the flat-cable ferrite-core category and every FSRC part now 404 in pim.murata.com / return empty from pimapi.murata.com). A 10 MHz spot is therefore included ONLY for the 2 parts whose exact Murata-published 10 MHz value is still recoverable (FSRC080120RTB00B=33 ohm, FSRC222120RX000T=14 ohm); both agree with the catalog's 100 MHz value. cable_max_mm = B 'Inner Dimension' nominal (the racetrack inner-opening width through which the flat cable passes; confirmed as the cable-width axis because FSRC140120/FSRC140200 share A=13.8/B=9.6 but differ only in H length 12 vs 20 mm and thus impedance 78 vs 126 ohm). Note: distributor-listed FSRC320120RT000T (Mouser, ~60 ohm @100MHz per search) is NOT in the O63E-10 catalog and its dimensions were not verifiable from a Murata primary source, so it is intentionally omitted rather than fabricated.
